observations: body L1, L3, L11-L12, L17, L25-L26, L28: the dashes of «Pseudo–Plutarcho», «Chaldaeo–hellenistica», of the transliterated names, of «151–152» and of «6–8» are long dashes (5.3 to 6.1 pt).
body L3, L28, L31: specks stand after «A», before «882» and above the p of «elapsi».
body L9, L25: in the heads the dashes after «b)» and «c)» and before «pag.» measure 10.0 to 10.4 pt and are transcribed as dashes.
body L26-L28: counted from 1 September, the year 1194 of Dhū ’l-qarnayn (the era of 312 B.C.) begins on 1 September 882, so 19 aylūl 1194 is 19 September 882.

body L30-L31: the era of Nabonassar begins on 26 February 747 B.C. (Julian day 1448638), not 748. From it to 26 February 882 there are 1628 Julian years, which are 1629 vague years and 42 days; the vague year that begins on 15 January 882 is therefore the 1630th of the era, and its 248th day, 8 Pachōn, is 19 September 882. Nallino's dates come out right because 1629 Julian years also exceed whole vague years by 42 days; his year number 1631 on p. 210 is one too high.
notes_left L2, notes_right L3, L6: the dashes of «35-36» (3.5 pt) and of «al-Battānī» and «Al-Battānī» (3.2 pt) are hyphens.
notes_right L2: 1 Pachōn of the fixed Alexandrian year is 26 April, so 8 Pachōn is 3 May.
notes_right L5: «παχώμ» is printed for παχών.
notes_right L12: the thetas of «ἀϑύρ» and «φαρμουϑί» are printed in the open form.
notes_right L13: the signature 27 stands at the foot of the page, below the right column of the notes.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
